主要内容: On February 6, 2013, Sangamo BioSciences, Inc. issued a press release announcing its financial results for the quarter and twelve months ended December 31, 2012. The report is filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and includes the company's financial statements and exhibits. The press release provides details on the company's financial performance for the specified periods. The filing is part of the company's compliance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The report was signed by Edward O. Lanphier II, the President and Chief Executive Officer of Sangamo BioSciences, Inc.
